name: Authyo OTP Authentication for WooCommerce
author: konceptwise

sections.description:
Authyo OTP Authentication for WooCommerce adds an extra layer of security and convenience by allowing users to log in or complete checkout using their phone number and a one-time password (OTP).

Features:
* OTP-based login for users
* OTP validation during checkout
* WooCommerce-compatible
* No need for passwords
* Works with mobile numbers
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/authyo-otp-authentication-for-woocommerce directory, or install it through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Authyo OTP to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does it work with the latest version of WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is tested with the latest WooCommerce release.

Can I use this plugin to replace password login?

Yes. You can disable password login by hiding the default login field and relying on OTP only.
